name: Anurag Chourasia
summary:
Dynamic iOS Engineer with around 4 years of experience delivering high-performance, production-grade mobile applications for global brands such as Lloyds, Halifax, BOS, MBNA, and ITC Hotels.

Specialized in Swift, Objective-C, SwiftUI, and modular architectures (MVVM, MVVM-C, MVC).

Proven expertise in CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (unit, UI, snapshot), and Agile/Scrum collaboration.

Passionate about building scalable, user-centric iOS applications.
